Rashi on Shabbat 38b:10:1.english: One may not place an egg next to an urn - A copper kettle.

Rashi on Shabbat 38b:10:2.hebrew: בשביל שתתגלגל - שתצלה קצת, עד שתהא מגלגלת:
Rashi on Shabbat 38b:10:2.english: So that it will roll - That it roast a little, until it rolls.

Rashi on Shabbat 38b:10:3.hebrew: ולא יפקיענה בסודרין - לא ישברנה על סודר שהוחם בחמה, כדי שתצלה מחומו של סודר:
Rashi on Shabbat 38b:10:3.english: And one may not crack it onto cloths - One may not break it onto a cloth that was heated in the sun, so that it will roast from the heat of the cloth.

Rashi on Shabbat 38b:10:4.hebrew: בחול ובאבק דרכים - שהוחמו מכח חמה. ובגמרא מפרש אמאי לא פליג רבי יוסי בהא:
Rashi on Shabbat 38b:10:4.english: In sand and in road dust - That were heated by the heat of the sun. And in the Gemara, it explains why Rabbi Yosei does not disagree in this [case].

Rashi on Shabbat 38b:11:1.english: And they ran a pipe - While it was still day [before Shabbat].

Rashi on Shabbat 38b:11:2.hebrew: של צונן - כדי לחממן, דהמים נמשכין ובאין כל השבת:
Rashi on Shabbat 38b:11:2.english: Of cold [water] - In order to heat it, for the water is drawn and comes throughout Shabbat.

Rashi on Shabbat 38b:11:3.english: Into a canal - Of the hot springs of Tiberias.

Rashi on Shabbat 38b:11:4.english: If on Shabbat - Those [waters] that came on Shabbat.

Rashi on Shabbat 38b:11:5.english: This is the reading: “Like hot water that was heated.”

Rashi on Shabbat 38b:1:1.hebrew: מחזירין אפילו בשבת - ביום המחרת. ולא תימא פלוגתייהו משחשכה, והתם הוא דשרו, משום דמוכחא מילתא דאדעתא דאהדורי לצורך מחר שקיל ליה; אבל ביום לא מוכח דשקיל ליה אדעתא דאהדורי, ובטלה לה הטמנה, וה"ל כמטמין לכתחלה:
Rashi on Shabbat 38b:1:1.english: One may return [it], even on Shabbat - On the following day. And do not say that their dispute was [only] once it grew dark, and that it is specifically there that they permitted [returning it], because it is evident that he took it with the intention of returning it for the needs of tomorrow; whereas during the day, it is not evident that he took it with the intention of returning it, and the insulation is nullified, and it would be like one who insulates initially.

Rashi on Shabbat 38b:1:4.english: To its place - To the stove.

Rashi on Shabbat 38b:2:1.hebrew: אבל הניח על גבי קרקע אסור - להחזיר, דבטלי לה הטמנה דאתמול, והוי כמטמין לכתחלה:
Rashi on Shabbat 38b:2:1.english: However, if he placed [it] on the ground, it is prohibited - To return [it], for yesterday’s insulation has ceased for it, and it is like one who insulates from the outset.

Rashi on Shabbat 38b:2:2.hebrew: לגרמיה - יחיד הוא בדבר, ואין הלכה כמותו:
Rashi on Shabbat 38b:2:2.english: For himself - He is a sole opinion in the matter, and the halakha is not in accordance with his view.

Rashi on Shabbat 38b:4:1.hebrew: תלאן במקל מהו - כעודן בידו דמי, או כהניחן ע"ג קרקע דמי:
Rashi on Shabbat 38b:4:1.english: [If] he hung them on a stick, what is [the law] - Is it considered as [if they are] still in his hand, or is it considered as [if] he placed them on the ground?

Rashi on Shabbat 38b:4:2.hebrew: פינן ממיחם למיחם מהו - מי הוי כמטמין לכתחלה, ואסור להחזירן לכירה, או לא:
Rashi on Shabbat 38b:4:2.english: [If] one transferred them from an urn to an urn, what is [the ruling] - Is it considered like [one who] insulates from the outset, and [therefore] it is forbidden to return them to the stove, or not?

Rashi on Shabbat 38b:4:3.english: An urn - A kettle in which one heats hot water.

Rashi on Shabbat 38b:5:1.hebrew: תנור - מתוך שקצר למעלה ורחב למטה, נקלט חומו לתוכו טפי מכירה:
Rashi on Shabbat 38b:5:1.english: An oven - Because it is narrow at the top and wide at the bottom, its heat is retained within it more than [in] a stove.

Rashi on Shabbat 38b:5:2.hebrew: כופח - בגמרא מפרש לה: עשוי חלל ככירה, אבל ארכו כרחבו, ואין בו אלא שיעור שפיתת קדירה אחת; וכירה — יש בה שפיתת שתי קדירות:
Rashi on Shabbat 38b:5:2.english: A kupaḥ - The Gemara explains it: It is made hollow like a kirah, but its length is equal to its width, and it has only the capacity for placing one pot, whereas a kirah has [space for] placing two pots.

Rashi on Shabbat 38b:6:2.english: However, to lean - Next to its wall.

Rashi on Shabbat 38b:6:3.hebrew: הא ככירה שרי - כלומר, מדקתני ״הרי הוא כתנור״, מכלל דאי הוה מדמי ליה לכירה — הוה שרי. ושמעינן מינה דכירה שהוסק בגפת ובעצים — שרי:
Rashi on Shabbat 38b:6:3.english: By inference, [if it were] like a stove, it is permitted - That is to say: From the fact that it teaches, “It is like an oven,” by implication, if it had compared it to a stove, it would be permitted. And we learn from this that a stove that was heated with pomace and with wood is permitted.

Rashi on Shabbat 38b:6:4.hebrew: ובמאי קאי - קס"ד בשאינה גרופה, ואי על גבה — מי שרי:
Rashi on Shabbat 38b:6:4.english: And in what [case] does it stand - It enters your mind [that the case is] when it is not swept; but if [it refers to placing it] on top of it, is it permitted?

Rashi on Shabbat 38b:7:1.english: It was taught in accordance with Abaye - That it is prohibited to lean [a pot] against an oven.

Rashi on Shabbat 38b:8:1.hebrew: אפי' בגפת ועצים - לשתרי בגרופה וקטומה:
Rashi on Shabbat 38b:8:1.english: Even with pomace and wood - It should be permitted when swept and covered with ashes.

Rashi on Shabbat 38b:9:1.hebrew: שנחלקה לאורכה - הרי בטלו שתי שפיתותיה, שנחלקת רחבה לשתים. הלכך, טהרה מטומאתה, שהרי ניתצה:
Rashi on Shabbat 38b:9:1.english: That was divided lengthwise - Behold, both of its pot-spaces are rendered unusable, as its width was divided in two. Therefore, it is purified from its [ritual] impurity, for it has been dismantled.

Rashi on Shabbat 38b:9:2.hebrew: נחלקה לרחבה - נמצאו שתי השפיתות קיימות, זו לבדה וזו לבדה:
Rashi on Shabbat 38b:9:2.english: [If] it was divided widthwise - Both places for placing [a pot] remain intact, this one on its own and that one on its own.

Rashi on Shabbat 38b:9:3.hebrew: כופח בין לאורכה בין לרחבה טהורה - שהרי ארכה כרחבה, וכולה מקום שפיתה אחת:
Rashi on Shabbat 38b:9:3.english: A kupaḥ, whether [divided] lengthwise or widthwise, is pure - For its length is equal to its width, and the whole of it is space for a single pot.

Tosafot on Shabbat 38b:10:1.hebrew: לא יטמיננה בחול - אע"ג דאמר בלא יחפור (ב"ב דף ימ. ושם) דחול: דקריר מקרר, דחמים מחים, והכא ביצה היא קרה — הכא מיירי בחול שהוחם בחמה, דומיא דאבק דרכים:
Tosafot on Shabbat 38b:10:1.english: "One may not insulate it in sand" - Even though [the Gemara] says in [the chapter] "Lo Yachpor" (Bava Batra 19a, and there [in Tosafot]) that sand cools [what is] cold and heats [what is] hot, and here an egg is cold — here [the Mishnah] is dealing with sand that was heated by the sun, similar to road dust.

Tosafot on Shabbat 38b:11:1.hebrew: מעשה והביאו סילון של צונן לתוך אמה של חמין כו' - מבעוד יום הביאוהו, כדפירש בקונטרס. ואין שום איסור כלל בהבאה, כדתניא בפרק קמא (דף יח.): "פותקין מים לגינה ומתמלאת והולכת כל השבת כולה". ואסרו ברחיצה — גזירה שמא יערבם בשבת; ולערבם בשבת אסור משום תולדות האור, וחשיבא כחדא גזירה. ואם היינו מפרשים דבסילון היו בו נקבים, וכשהיו רוחצים בשבת היו פותחים הנקבים ומתערבין הצוננין בחמין — הוה אתי שפיר טפי, דהשתא ליכא אלא חדא גזירה אטו חמי האור. אך בגמרא מדמי לה להטמנה מבעוד יום, ויליף מינה לאסור להטמין מבעוד יום בדבר המוסיף הבל — גזירה שמא יטמין ברמץ ושמא יחתה. ולר"י נראה, דמה שהיו מתערבין צונן בחמין לא הוה דמי להטמנה, וליכא למילף מינה, דאיכא למימר דאסרי להו מפני שמבשל המים צוננין. ונראה לו דסילון לא היה מתערב בחמין, כי היה מוקף מחיצות מכל צד, והיו מתחממין המים צוננים שבסילון מחמת חמי טבריא, ולא היו רוחצות בחמי טבריא עצמן לפי שריחן רע; והשתא דמיא להטמנה, שמים צוננין היו נטמנין בתוך החמין להתחמם:
Tosafot on Shabbat 38b:11:1.english: "An incident occurred where they ran a cold-water pipe through a canal of hot water, etc." - They ran it while it was still day [before Shabbat], as explained in the Kuntres. And there is no prohibition whatsoever in running [the water before Shabbat], as it is taught in a baraita in the first chapter (18a): "One may open [a channel of] water into a garden, and it continues to fill all Shabbat long." And [yet] they prohibited [the water] for bathing as a decree lest one mix them on Shabbat; and to mix them on Shabbat is prohibited due to [the prohibition against heating with] products of fire, and it is considered a single decree. And if we were to explain that in the pipe there were perforations, and when they would bathe on Shabbat they would open the perforations and the cold [water] would mix with the hot [water], it would work out much better, for now there is only a single decree on account of [water heated by] products of fire. However, in the Gemara [the Gemara] compares it to insulating [food or liquid] from while it is still day, and derives from it to prohibit insulating from while it is still day in a substance that adds heat — [which itself is] a decree lest one insulate in hot ashes and lest one rake [the coals]. And to the Ri it appears that [if] cold [water] mixed with hot [water], it would not resemble insulation, and one could not derive [the law of insulation] from it, for one could say that they prohibited it because he is cooking the cold water. And it appears to him that the pipe did not mix with the hot water, because it was enclosed by walls on all sides, and the cold water inside the pipe would heat up from the heat of the hot springs of Tiberias; and they would not bathe in the hot springs of Tiberias themselves because their odor was bad. And now [under this explanation], it resembles insulation, as cold water was insulated inside the hot water in order to heat up.

Tosafot on Shabbat 38b:1:1.hebrew: אפילו בשבת - פירש בקונטרס: בשבת — ביום המחרת. ולפ"ז, ה"ל למינקט: "אפי' ביום השבת". ולמאי דפרישית, דעיקר פלוגתייהו בחול — אתי שפיר:
Tosafot on Shabbat 38b:1:1.english: "Even on Shabbat" - Rashi explained: "On Shabbat" — [means] on the following day. And according to this, [the Gemara] should have formulated [it]: "Even on the day of Shabbat." But according to what I explained, that the core of their dispute is on a weekday, it works out well.

Tosafot on Shabbat 38b:4:1.hebrew: פינה ממיחם למיחם מהו - וא"ת, דבפרק במה טומנין (לקמן שבת דף נא.) תניא: "וכן היה רשב"ג אומר: לא אסרו אלא באותו מיחם, אבל פינה ממיחם למיחם — מותר", אלמא במיחם אחר שרי טפי, והכי משמע איפכא! ואור"ת: דהכא גבי השהה ע"ג כירה, כשהוא באותו מיחם שהוא חם — לא אתי לחתויי, אבל במיחם אחר שהוא קר — אתי לחתויי; אבל גבי הטמנה — שרי טפי כשהוא קר, דבחיתוי מועט לא יועיל:
Tosafot on Shabbat 38b:4:1.english: If one transferred them from urn to urn, what is [the ruling] - And if you say: For in the chapter [entitled] Bameh Tomnin (below, Shabbat 51a), it is taught: "And so Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel would say: They prohibited [insulating] only in that same urn, but if one transferred [it] from urn to urn, it is permitted" — which implies that [transferring it] into another urn is more permissible, yet here it implies the opposite! And Rabbeinu Tam says: Here, regarding leaving [an urn] on top of a stove, when it is in that same urn, which is hot, one will not come to stoke [the coals]; but in another urn, which is cold, one will come to stoke [the coals]. However, regarding insulating, it is more permissible when it is cold, for slight stoking will not be effective.

Tosafot on Shabbat 38b:4:2.hebrew: ורשב"א מפרש בשם ר"י, דהתם בהטמנה, דהוי לצורך מחר — ליכא למיחש לחיתויי, דבלא חיתוי יתחמם הרבה; אבל הכא, דבעי לה בלילה — איכא למיחש לחיתויי. ומיהו, קצת משמע התם דמיירי במטמין בלילה (ת"י):
Tosafot on Shabbat 38b:4:2.english: And the Rashba explains in the name of the Ri that there, regarding insulating [hatmanah], which is for tomorrow's needs, there is no concern that one might stoke [the coals], for without stoking it will become plenty hot; but here, where he needs it tonight, there is concern that one might stoke [the coals]. However, it somewhat implies there that it is dealing with one who insulates at night. (Tosefot Yeshanim)

Tosafot on Shabbat 38b:5:1.hebrew: תנור שהסיקוהו בקש ובגבבא לא יתן כו' - אי להחזיר תנן, הכא נמי: האי "לא יתן" — "לא יחזיר"; אבל להשהות — משהה, אפילו בתנור שאינו גרוף וקטום; כדמשמע בפ"ק (דף יח:) דשרינן קידרא חייתא ובשיל כמאכל בן דרוסאי אפילו באינו גרוף וקטום, ומשמע התם דבתנור איירי, דקאי אהא דקתני התם לעיל: "לא תמלא אשה קדרה עססיות כו'":
Tosafot on Shabbat 38b:5:1.english: "An oven that they lit with straw or rakings, one may not place, etc." - If we learned [that the Mishnah refers to] returning, here too, this "one may not place" [means] one may not return [it]; but to leave [food in it before Shabbat] — one may leave [it], even in an oven that is neither swept nor covered with ashes. As is indicated in the first chapter (18b), where we permit [leaving] a pot of raw [food] and [food] cooked like the food of Ben Drosai even in [an oven] that is neither swept nor covered with ashes; and it implies there that it is dealing with an oven, for it relates to that which was taught there above: "A woman may not fill a pot with asasyot [and place it into the oven], etc."

Tosafot on Shabbat 38b:6:1.hebrew: אילימא בשאינה גרופה - האי לישנא לאו דוקא, דאביי סבר דלא מיתוקמה בגרופה, דבגרופה לא מסתבר ליה שיהא חילוק בין גפת ועצים לקש וגבבא. דאי הוה מצי אביי לאוקמה בגרופה, כדמוקי לה רב אדא, לא הוה מצי למפשט מידי. ורב אדא דמוקי לה בגרופה סבר דיש לעולם יותר חום כשהסיקוה בגפת ובעצים, אע"ג דגרופה, מבקש ובגבבא:
Tosafot on Shabbat 38b:6:1.english: "If you say when it is not swept" - This formulation is not exact, for Abaye held that it cannot be established [as referring to a kupaḥ that is] swept, because in [the case of a] swept [one], it did not seem reasonable to him that there would be a distinction between pomace and wood and straw and rakings. For had Abaye been able to establish it [as referring to a] swept [one], as Rav Adda establishes it, he would not have been able to resolve anything. And Rav Adda, who establishes it [as referring to a] swept [one], maintains that there is always more heat when they lit it with pomace and wood, even though it is swept, than [when lit] with straw and rakings.

Tosafot on Shabbat 38b:7:1.hebrew: תניא כוותיה דאביי כו' - יש דגרסי בסיפא: "כופח שהסיקוהו בגפת ובעצים אין סומכין לה" — דאי גרס "סומכין לה", לא אתא כוותיה דאביי, דאית ליה דבכופח נמי אין סומכין, כדאמרינן לעיל. וי"ל, דאי גרסינן "סומכין", איכא לאוקמה בגרופה, ונקט גפת ועצים לרבותא, דאפילו הכי סומכין לה:
Tosafot on Shabbat 38b:7:1.english: "It is taught in accordance with Abaye, etc." - Some read in the concluding clause: "A kupaḥ that one lit with pomace and with wood, one may not lean [a pot] against it" — for if one reads "one may lean against it," it would not come in accordance with Abaye, who maintains that with a kupaḥ as well one may not lean [against it], as we said above. And it can be said that if we read "one may lean," it can be established [as dealing with a kupaḥ that is] swept, and it mentions pomace and wood as a novelty, that even so, one may lean against it.
